findings_detail.note: Two synthetic pypi- token strings used as raw input to assert redact_secrets() removes them. Never stored; not real tokens.
All are input strings to exercise redact_secrets(). Clearly synthetic (contain 'fake', 'EXAMPLE', 'abcde' sequences or ABCDE uppercase runs). No real credentials.
Literal string 'AKIA1234567890EXAMPLE' written to pytest tmp_path to exercise SecurityReviewerAgent detection. Not at rest; not a real AWS key.
_FAKE_PYPI_TOKEN = 'fake-pypi-token-abc123' and _FAKE_ANTHROPIC_KEY = 'sk-ant-fake-anthropic-key-xyz789'. Both variables named FAKE_*; used only to inject synthetic env for integration assertions.
Multiple fake_token/fake_key variables with clearly synthetic values (contain 'fake', 'mock', 'ABCDE' uppercase sequences). Integration tests for the redaction pipeline.
Regex pattern declarations: sk-, ghp_, gho_, pypi-, xoxb-, PEM. These are denylist strings used to match and redact real secrets from output — not credential values.
Denylist constant string used to detect PEM blocks in reviewed code.
_SECRET_PATTERNS tuple used for detection, not credential storage.
Placeholder ellipsis strings in export examples. No real key material.
Placeholder ellipsis strings in tutorial JSON example. Not real keys.
Literal text '<pypi-sdist-url>' in a checklist template item — angle-bracket placeholder, not a token.
Secrets context reference ${{ secrets.PYPI_API_TOKEN }} — GitHub Actions secrets interpolation, never a raw value in the file.

pypi_token_comment: Zero pypi-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{50,} matches across all git-tracked files. The two pypi- strings found (pypi-AgEI***) are 30-38 chars (below real token length of 150+) and are synthetic test inputs in tests/unit/test_secret_redaction.py. No PyPI token exists in git-tracked content or in git history diffs.
gh_secret_comment: PYPI_API_TOKEN is present in GitHub Actions secrets. Updated_at timestamp 2026-05-14T07:44:23Z confirms it was set or rotated today. Secret value is not accessible via API (by design). Metadata only.

mitigations_present.secret_redaction_detail: 123 lines; covers OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, PYPI_API_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN env-var patterns; sk-, ghp_, gho_, pypi-, xoxb- token prefix patterns; PEM private key blocks.

rotation_recommended_because: The PyPI token value was pasted in chat history once. Although this audit confirms the token was never written to any git-tracked file, never appeared in CLI argv (set via printf | gh secret set), and is absent from all validation outputs, defense-in-depth policy recommends rotation before any production use. The updated_at of 2026-05-14T07:44:23Z suggests the secret may have already been rotated today — if so, rotation is complete. If not yet rotated, rotate now at pypi.org > Account Settings > API tokens.
